profile.dividendPolicy:
The company has a dividend policy to distribute dividends at a minimum rate of 40% of net profit, after accounting for statutory reserves and other reserves as per the company's financial performance. However, the distribution of dividends may be subject to change contingent upon net cash flows, financial position, operational performance, investment initiatives, and other relevant considerations deemed suitable by the board of directors and/or shareholders of the company. Regardless, any alternation in dividend distributions must maximize benefits to shareholders.
The authorization of dividend disbursements lies within the purview of the board of directors, in which they are required to raise in the shareholders' meeting for consideration. An exemption applies in the case of interim dividends, where the board of directors has the authority to approve and inform shareholders in the subsequent meeting.
